note: PROPOSAL, not game data. The TM/HM proposal for Familiar (docs/TM-HM.md). Checked by `node sim/tm-check.mjs`. Nothing in data/ reads this file. In `can`, a key is a character id, or `id/N` when only form N and later forms learn it; the value is the canon reason. `cannot` lists characters a player would expect on the list, with the reason they are not. `demo` entries are moves that should stay off Patterns, tested only to show why.
